Name: GAME_PRESENCE_PARAM
Description: Game presence states and what the system may do while the game is in each state.

Fields.Name: Allow Automatic Transition
Fields.Description: If ON, the game can automatically transition out of this state.

Fields.Name: Allow System Error Handling
Fields.Description: If ON, system errors can be handled while in this state.

Fields.Name: Request Pause
Fields.Description: If ON, the game pauses while in this state.
